title: Founded venture capital firm Innovation Works in 2009
statement: Founded venture capital firm Innovation Works in 2009, later renamed Sinovation Ventures, investing in AI startups.

title: Founded 01
statement: Founded 01.AI in 2023, a Beijing-based AI company building agentic tools for companies worldwide using customized open-source models.
outcome: As of the February 2026 interview, Lee described 01.AI as actively engaged with traditional-industry clients on AI-agent adoption, though the source did not report specific revenue, client-count, or model-performance metrics for the company.
